questions.q: What proportion of seating in covered waiting areas is designated as priority seating in the revised IRR?
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: The revised IRR specifies at least 5% priority seating for persons with disabilities.

questions.q: What is the minimum clear width for doors under the 2024 Revised IRR?
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: The revised IRR states that all doors shall have a minimum clear width of 900 mm.

questions.q: Which later Philippine law expressly reinforces the State's duty to attain a barrier-free environment and references BP 344?
questions.ref: Republic Act No. 7277, Sec. 25
questions.n: RA 7277, the Magna Carta for Disabled Persons, states that the State shall ensure a barrier-free environment and expressly refers to BP 344.

questions.q: At what height are door handles, pulls, latches, and lever-type locksets centered under the revised IRR?
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: The revised IRR centers accessible door hardware at 900 mm above floor finish.

questions.q: A proposed public door has an 820 mm clear opening. Does it meet the 2024 Revised IRR minimum?
o: No; it is below the 900 mm minimum
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: The required minimum clear door opening is 900 mm.

questions.q: What minimum clear elevator door opening is specified?
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: Accessible elevators require a clear door opening of at least 900 mm.

questions.q: Which of the following is explicitly cited by BP 344 as an example of an accessibility feature?
questions.ref: Batas Pambansa Blg. 344, Sec. 1
questions.n: The law expressly mentions sidewalks, ramps, railings, and similar features.

questions.q: What is the purpose of tactile warning blocks?
o: To alert users with visual disabilities to hazards, changes in level, or important transition points
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: Warning tactile surfaces signal hazards and transitions along accessible routes.

questions.q: What is an accessible route?
o: A continuous unobstructed path connecting accessible elements and spaces that can be negotiated safely and independently
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: The revised IRR defines an accessible route as a continuous unobstructed path connecting accessible elements and spaces.

questions.q: What general performance is required of accessible flooring?
o: It should be slip-resistant, level, and free of tripping hazards
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: The revised IRR emphasizes slip resistance, level surfaces, and removal of tripping hazards.

questions.q: Under the 2024 Revised IRR, what is the general maximum ramp gradient before special-case steeper gradients are considered?
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: The revised IRR gives a general gradient not steeper than 1:20, with steeper gradients allowed only under specified special conditions.

questions.q: In the older IRR's separately enumerated list of architectural features, which of these was not listed as its own category?
questions.ref: BP 344 Implementing Rules and Regulations, architectural facilities/features list
questions.n: The older BP 344 IRR separately enumerated doors/entrances, floor finishes, lifts/elevators, seating accommodations, and others; windows were not a separate category in that list.

questions.q: How is clear door opening measured for a swing door under the revised IRR?
o: Across the frame including the door leaf
From wall centerline to wall centerline
From the face of the door opened 90° to the door jamb
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: The revised IRR defines the clear opening with the leaf fully open at 90 degrees.

questions.q: A public entrance is 600 mm above site grade. Under the revised IRR, what should be provided if direct level access is not possible?
o: An accessible ramp, wheelchair lift, or similar accessible mechanism
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: Where entrances are not at site-arrival grade, the revised IRR requires an accessible ramp, wheelchair lift, or similar mechanism.

questions.q: For ordinary building provisions in the 2024 Revised IRR, what minimum clear elevator-car size is specified?
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: The revised IRR specifies a minimum clear car dimension of 1400 mm in depth and 1200 mm in width for accessible building elevators.

questions.q: What is the central purpose of BP 344?
o: To enhance mobility and access for persons with disabilities by requiring architectural facilities and structural features
questions.ref: Batas Pambansa Blg. 344, Sec. 1
questions.n: BP 344 requires accessibility features in covered buildings, establishments, institutions, and public utilities.

questions.q: What accessibility features must elevator control buttons include for users with visual disabilities?
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: The revised IRR requires Braille adjacent to controls and tactile buttons.

questions.q: What must covered parking facilities provide for persons with disabilities?
o: Sufficient and suitable reserved parking space
questions.ref: Batas Pambansa Blg. 344, Sec. 1
questions.n: BP 344 requires suitable parking space for use by persons with disabilities.

questions.q: What is the standard block size stated for directional, warning, and positional tactile blocks in the revised IRR?
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: The revised IRR specifies 300 mm square tactile blocks.

questions.q: Under the 2024 Revised IRR, what is the general minimum clear width of an accessible ramp?
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: The 2024 Revised IRR specifies a 1200 mm minimum clear ramp width.
